correctness.rationale: For every integer m≥2 and cycle lengths ℓ_i≥3, the directed-arc transitions and stationary probabilities are explicit. Deterministic tour elimination gives the full non-backtracking characteristic polynomial and yields K_nb from its simple root at 1; the ordinary edge constant follows from the one-separation effective-resistance identity plus edge/vertex nonzero-spectrum preservation. Differentiation proves the edge-minus-NB gap strictly increases in each length on the entire real orthant ≥3. One m≥3 baseline and four m=2 exact base cases finish the infinite sign classification. A standalone checker independently constructs arc transition matrices and verifies 799 exact rational comparisons. Periodicity and finite-check limitations are stated.

value.rationale: The finite family of unweighted one-hub cycle bouquets is a natural test of the 2022 non-backtracking-versus-ordinary edge Kemeny comparison, while its arbitrary cycle lengths can destroy symmetry. The theorem classifies every such graph, explains which two small obstructions reverse the expected order and proves a single tie, using a structural tour polynomial and a strict monotonicity theorem. This provides a motivated boundary on random-target hitting performance, not a numeric or routine substitution observation.
